subject: Real Madrid reportedly still tracking Bayern's Michael Olise
title: Real Madrid still tracking Olise

lines.vo: Real Madrid still want Olise. Bayern are pretending not to notice.
Olise is twenty-four, and ESPN ranks him third in the world. Bronze medal, gold-medal queue.
L'Équipe reports Real remain interested. It is a rumour, not a bid, and no fee was reported.
Several top clubs reportedly want him next summer. His Bayern deal then has two years left.
Two years left is a shop window. Real Madrid are not buying yet. They are just pressing their nose on the glass.
